The food looks like scrambled eggs on a white plate. The plate appears to be about 20-22 cm across, and the eggs cover roughly 10-12 cm. They form a modest pile about 2-3 cm high.

That gives a volume of roughly 150-200 mL. Scrambled eggs weigh about 0.8-1 g/mL, so the portion is around 150 g.

Scrambled eggs made with butter come to about 1.6 kcal/g, so 150 g is about 240 kcal. Allowing a little extra for the oil they were cooked in, I settled on about 250 kcal.
